purpose: Teach: アワ/ニャン/童貞/メヒコ/ペセタ/ルーシー/レヴィナス/スラブ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家族旅行で徳島のアワ、つまり粟料理食べたろ
lines.en: Riku — you ate Awa cuisine when your family went to Tokushima, remember?
lines.style: Teasing opener, light challenge in the tone. Quick pace, playful energy. Like she's caught him in something small and is enjoying the moment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ペットの猫に「ニャン」って話しかけてたな、桜
lines.en: You were the one talking to your cat in baby-voice, Sakura.
lines.style: Quick deflection with a slight smirk underneath. Dry, even-keeled delivery. Not mean—just turning it back on her without drama.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、漫画で「童貞」キャラ多いって笑ってたな
lines.en: Riku — you were laughing at all those virgin characters in manga back then.
lines.style: Lighter now, almost conspiratorial. Calling out something embarrassing but with warmth. The tone of someone who remembers and won't let him forget, but nicely.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でメキシコをスペイン語のメヒコ呼びしてたな、桜
lines.en: You were the one pronouncing Mexico as 'Mehico' in social studies, Sakura.
lines.style: Calm counter-volley. Matter-of-fact, slightly amused at the memory. Not defensive, just returning serve with a small half-smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で旧スペインのペセタ知ったろ
lines.en: Riku — didn't you learn about the Spanish peseta in social studies that semester?
lines.style: Softer curiosity now, genuine interest creeping in. Like she's following a thread of what he knows. Still playful but less pointed—moving toward real conversation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ピーナッツのルーシー好きだったよな、桜
lines.en: You were such a Lucy fan from Peanuts, though, remember?
lines.style: Warmer observation, almost affectionate. Slower pace here. Like she's remembering something about him she actually liked, softening the earlier banter.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、倫理の授業でレヴィナス習ったろ
lines.en: Riku — I remember you learning about Levinas in ethics class.
lines.style: Genuine now, the teasing mostly gone. Quiet admiration underneath. Speaking from a place of actually noticing what he pays attention to, what matters to him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でスラブ系言語の特集調べてたな、桜
lines.en: You spent all that time researching Slavic languages for your social studies project.
lines.style: Tender observation, close and knowing. Slow, deliberate pace. The voice of someone who watched him care about something and noticed. Intimate without being loud.
